mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it showed that the cord can also help produce rapid responses without waiting for a conscious decision.

leastWorthwhile.text: Protecting the brain and spinal cord was clear but predictable: each bone already had a matching outline.

surprise.text: I was surprised that incoming and outgoing signals use separate fibres within the same nerve.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless, but joining the sensory and motor fibres was less obvious until the result showed them sharing a covering rather than becoming one fibre.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: the rapid-response detail and the separate nerve fibres made me curious about how signals lead to movement, although the choices here were often straightforward.
